simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶתְנִי (H867) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֶתְנִי (ʼEthnîy) means Ethni , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 6 26.

definitions.full: H867. Ethni אֶתְנִי proper name, masculine an ancestor of Asaph 1Chr 6:26 apparently identical with יְאָֽתְרַי v. 6:6 . אֶתְנַן see II. תנן .
